title: Isis Astarte Diana Hecate
about: The Goddess Chant — seven names sung in a ring: Isis, Astarte, Diana, Hecate, Demeter, Kali, Inanna. The words are credited to Deena Metzger, the melody to Caitlin Mullin; from women’s ritual circles it passed into the fire-circle and Rainbow repertoires. It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, p.5, song #24, with a second entry at p.12, song #49. The melody here follows the singing on a recorded Goddess Chant performance on YouTube.
melody_note: Transcribed by song2xml from YouTube DJZHabrymNc (90s clip, no separation). 53.5% words fit. NOTE: notation-sources/hecate.pdf is Patricia Witt's 'Hecate, Cerridwen' — a different chant (Hoof and Horn companion), not this one. Awaiting verification.
